senses.gloss:
(I)--the grand-father of the पाण्डवस् by mother's line;
1: भा. I. १४. २६; III. 1. २६.
father of Vasudeva.
2: Ib. X. 1. २९; 3. ४७ and ५१.

(II)--a son of वीदूरथ and father of भजमान. (शमि, वि। प्।).
1: भा. IX. २४. २६; Vi. IV. १४. २३.
A great king and father of eight sons.
2: Br. III. ७१. १३७-9.
[page३-456+ ३०]
(IV)--a son of मदिरा and Vasudeva. भा. IX. २४. ४८.
(V)--a son of कृष्ण and भद्रा: His picture drawn by Citralekha. भा. X. ६१. १७; ६२. २०.
(VI)--a kingdom: Dvijas of this became व्रात्यस् after Puramjaya's days. भा. XII. 1. ३८.

(VIII)--a son of अश्मकि? (Devagarbha-वि। प्।): wife महिषा or भोजा (मारीषा-वि। प्।); Father of ten sons, the eldest being Vasudeva: also of 5 daughters;
1: Br. III. ७१. १४४, १५१; Vi. IV. १४. २५-7.
had a friend कुन्ती who was childless; to him he gave his daughter पृथा in adoption; पाण्डु married her.
2: Ib. IV. १४. ३२-4.
(IX)--a son of अगावह. Br. III. ७१. २५७.
(X)--a name of वीग्नेश्वर. Br. IV. ४४. ६८. [page३-457+ ३०]
(XI)--a son of ऐक्ष्वाकि; married भोजा and had १० sons and 5 daughters. M. ४६. 1, 4.
(XII)--a son of भजमान; wife अस्मकी; had a number of sons, वात, निवात, etc. वा. ९६. १३५-6, १४३.
--otherwise Kubera. भा. X. १०. 7.
(I)--is स्तुता; mother of Kali; as वारुणि devi1. Br. III. ५९. 9; IV. 9. ६५.

(II)--six different varieties of liquor drunk by the शक्तिस् on the third day of the war; गौडी, पैष्ती, माध्वी, कादम्बरी, हैताली, लाङ्गलेया and तालजात; also that from कल्पवृक्ष; they were of different tastes, sweet, bitter, [page३-662+ २७] saltish, etc., and of various colours;
1: Br. IV. २८. ७१-6; वा. १०१. १६२.
liquor with Kaca's powdered body mixed in it taken by शुक्राचार्य and thus deceived by the Asura; hence he ordained that no Brahman should thereafter take liquor, and if he did he would fall from his status and commit a sin equal to brahmicide and would be despised by the world at large.
2: M. २५. ३९, ६०, ६२-3; ७६. १२.
(III)--the sea of liquor. M. 2. ३४.
(IV)--the wife of Kali; son of Mada. वा. ८४. 9.
(II)--a disciple of श्रिन्गिपुत्र. वा. ६१. ४०.
(XIII)--the country of the. Vi. II. 3. १६.
(I)--the gods who adopted सुरा of वारुणि Devi1 which sprung forth from the churning of the ocean. Br. IV. 9. ६९.
(II)--the names of gods during Manvantara. वा. ६१. ७६.
--a daughter of Ugrasena and wife of श्यामक. भा. IX. २४. २५ and ४२.
(I) (च्)--the kingdom of Citraketu. भा. VI. १४. १०; XI. ३०. १८.
(III)--the Lord of the Yadus and overlord of माथुरस् and शूरसेनस्. भा. X. 1. २७.
(IV)--a son of शत्रुघ्न: capital मथुरा. Br. III. ६३. १८७; वा. ८८. १८६; Vi. IV. 4. १०४.
--a son of कर्ण. वा. ९९. ११२.
--praised the heroic exploits of Hari. भा. IX. २४. ६३.
--a name of कृष्ण born to Devaki. M. ४६. १५.
--the last son of शिवदत्त. Br. III. ३५. १३.
--a name of विनायक. Br. III. ४२. ३७; IV. ४४. ६७.

--a daughter of विश्रवस् and कैकसी; sister of रावण;
2: Br. III. 8. ४७.
disfigured by राम.
3: भा. IX. १०. 4.
^1 वा. ७०. ४१.
--the wind of a winnowing basket blowing upon a person, makes him lose his lustre. Vi. V. ३८. ४०.
--sages of this place visited द्वारका; visited by बलराम. भा. X. ९०. २८ [5]; ७९. २०.
(I)--a son of निरामित्र, ruled for ५६ years. M. २७१. २२.
(II)--the १४थ् Vya1sa, Gautama, the अवतार् of the Lord. वा. २३. १६२.
(I)--the son of रणक and father of Sumitra. भा. IX. १२. १५.
(II)--a son of Janhu and father of विदूरथ. भा. IX. २२. 9-१०; M. ५०. ३४; वा. ९९. २३०; Vi. IV. २०. 2-3. [page३-658+ २९]
(III)--a son of Kulaka. M. २७१. १३; वा. ९९. २३०.
(IV)--a son of Janamejaya. वा. ९९. २२९.
(V)--a son of कुण्डक and father of Sumitra. Vi. IV. २२. 9-१०.
--a daughter of दक्ष. M. १७१. २९.
--see शरद्वत्. Br. III. ७४. ५९.

(I)--the mythical cow: a daughter of दक्ष and one of कश्यप's wives; gave birth to cattle and those with cloven hoofs;
1: भा. I. १७. 9; VI. 6. २६-27; M. 5. ३२; ६२, ४४; वा. ६६. ५५; Vi. I. १५. १२५; २१. २४.
came with Indra to see कृष्ण. Pleased with his good will for the cattle kingdom, she told him that he was chosen Indra of goloka. Then she bathed him in her milk while Indra bathed him with Ganges water and called him Govinda, to the singing and dancing of celestials; a mother goddess; mother of eleven Rudras
2: Ib. X. २७. 1-२४.
and two daughters, रोहिणी and गान्धारी also was born वृषोदक्ष, the latter presented as the banner of महेश्वर;
3: Br. III. 3. ५६, ६९, ७८. 7: ४६६; ७४. ४९ and ९०; M. ४८. ४३-84; १४६. १८; वा. ७०-76.
blessed दीर्- gatamas who heckled her son for eating sacrificial grass to get rid of all sins and to become the renowned Gautama.

(III)--a forest garden on the banks of the Vam- शौकसारा;
1: M. १२१. ६१.
a garden of gods.
2: Br. III. 7. १०१.
(IV)--wife of Dharma; longed for union with ब्रह्मा; their children were Rudras, cattle, medicinal plants and so on. M. १७१. ३५-42; २७७. 8.
(V)--a mind-born mother. M. १७९. १२; २५१. 2.

(VI)--a forest on the bank of शैलोदा. R. in the अरुण hill;
1: वा. ४७. २२.
fit for tapas.
2: वा. ६९. ९४.
(VIII)--a Gandharva with the sun in the शरत् season. वा. ५२. १३.
--a नाग with one hundred heads resid- ing in रसातलम्; also वासुकी, a friend of Indra. Br. II. २०. ४०.
--a Marut of the second गण. Br. III. 5. ९३.
--an image of Indra, with इन्द्रानी. M. २६०. ६६-70. [page३-660+ २९]
--an यक्ष lady of lustrous brightness; origi- nates गण through करालक. वा. ६९. ३८.
--one of Danu's sons. वा. ६८. 6.
(I)--Mt. in India. Br. II. १६. २१; वा. ४५. ९०.
(II)--a son of शुकि and गरुड. Br. III. 7. ४५०.
(III)--a son of Raucya Manu. Br. IV. 1. १०४; वा. १००. १०९.
(IV)--a Mt. west of the शितोद. वा. ३६. २७.
(I)--R. in भारत vars2a, from the ऋक्ष hill; (from the Vindhyas-वि। प्।). भा. V. १९. १८; Br. II. १६. २९; Vi. II. 3. ११.

(II)--a daughter of दक्ष and one of the १३ wives of कश्यप;
1: भा. VI. 6. २५, २८; M. 6. 1, ३७-8, ४२; वा. ६६. ५४; Vi. I. १५. १२४; २१. १९.
mother of यातुधानस् and १००० snakes, of which २६ are chiefs; all these had sons and grandsons most of which were killed in the sacrifice of Jana- mejaya;
1: भा. VI. 6. २५, २८; M. 6. 1, ३७-8, ४२; वा. ६६. ५४; Vi. I. १५. १२४; २१. १९.
in the chariot of त्रिपुरारि.
2: M. १३३. २७; १४६. १८.
[page३-661+ २५]
(III)--an Apsaras. Br. III. 7. 8; वा. ६९. 7.
(IV)--a daughter of क्रोधवश (क्रोधा- वि। प्।) and wife of Pulaha; mother of सर्पस्। Br. III. 7. १७३, ४४३; वा. ६९. २०५.
(V)--a daughter of सारण. Br. III. ७१. १६८; वा. ९६. १६६.
(VI)--a daughter of अनायुषा, gave birth to व्याधिस्। M. १७१. ५९.
(VII)--a mind-born mother. M. १७९. १९.
(VIII)--a R. of the Bhadra. वा. ४३. २५.
--a pleasure garden to which Kardama and देवहूती went. भा. III. २३. ४०.
--a राक्षस who married नील, daughter of केशिनी. Br. III. 7. १४७.
--a daughter of वरुण and शुनादेवी. Br. III. ५९. 6; वा. ८४. 6.
--is Skanda. वा. ५३. ३१.
--an Asura in the सभा of हिरण्यकशीपु. M. १६१. ७९.
--a daughter of नाग्नजित्. वा. ९६. २४३.
--issued from the milk ocean when it was churned. M. २५०. 3.
--a देवी on the Geyacakra. Br. IV. १९. ७५.
--a राक्षष who was killed in लन्का war. भा. IX. १०. १८. [page३-663+ २४]

--the drinking of spirituous liquors leads to the सूकर hell.
2: Br. IV. 2. १५४, १६७.
^1 वा. १०१. १५२.
--a group of gods of the XII epoch of Manu. Vi. III. 2. ३४.
--is मदिरा sindhu. Br. IV. २८. ७०.
(I)--a sage and a सम्हिता कर्ता। Br. II. ३५. ४५.
--of the southern country. वा. ४५. १२९.
--a R. of the भद्रा country. वा. ४३. ३०.
--a western kingdom visited by Vidura from the सरस्वती. Its king attacked the eastern side of Gomanta with जरासन्ध. भा. II. १६. ६२; M. १६३. ७२. भा. III. 1. २४; X ५२. ११ [5].
--of the south. वा. ४५. १३१. [page३-664+ २७]
--is मदीरा sindhu. Br. IV. २०. ७६.
(I)--the यक्ष presiding over the month of Tapas. भा. XII. ११. ३९.
(II)--a Gandharva with the sun in the शरत् season. Br. II. २३. १३; III. 7. ११.
(III)--a son of मरीचि. वा. ६५. ११०.
(V)--resides in the आश्वयुज in the Sun's chariot. Vi. II. १०. ११.
--a वानर chief. Br. III. 7. २४२.
(I)--a son of शुकी and गरुड. Br. III. 7. ४५०.
(II)--an Asura in the सभा of हिरण्यकशिपु. M. १६१. ८०. [page३-665+ २६]
(III)--a son of मणिवर. वा. ६९. १६१.
(IV)--the adopted son of Asamanjasa. वा. ९६. १४१.
(V)--an Andhaka. Vi. ९६. १४१.
(I)--a daughter of मरीचि and wife of Atharvan अन्गीरस्; had ten sons. Br. III. 1. १०२; M. १९६. 1; वा. ६५. ९८, १०५.
(II)--a daughter of रोहिणी; mother of two sons. Br. III. 3. ७४-5.
(III)--a कल giving energy to Agni. Br. IV. ३५. ८३.
(IV)--a daughter of वृकदेवी. वा. ९६. १८०.
--a group of gods of तामस Manu. Br. II. ३५. ४३.
a Janapada of the केतुमाला continent. वा. ४४. १४.

--a daughter of विश्वकर्मा, sister of Maya; wife of the Sun god; known as सम्ज्ञा; gave birth to Manu and then to twins Yama and यमुना! took the guise of a horse and wandered in the Kuru country and became the horse of सविता; through her two nostrils were born अश्विन्स्. also known as नासत्य and Dasra. Unable to bear the sun's rays, she requested छाया to take her place and guise until [page३-666+ २३] she returned; she went home, but after some time her father turned her out. Br. III. ५९. २१, ३४; वा. ८४. २१-24, २६-86.
--one of the ११ Rudras. M. 5. २९.
--आर्षेय pravara (Angiras). M. १९६. 8.
--a territorial division of शाल्मलिद्वीप. भा. V. २०. 9.
--one of the seven sons of वसिष्ठ. भा. IV. 1. ४१.
--an Apsaras. वा. ६९. 4.
--the sea of wine surrounding शाल्मलिद्वीप. भा. V. 1. ३३; २०. 7; M. १२२. १०४; १२३. 1; Vi. II. 4. ३३.
--the city of राक्षसस् in रसातलम्. Br. II. २०. ४०.
--of the southern country. वा. ४५. १२८.
--a queen of अनुह्राद. भा. VI. १८. १६.
(III)--a son of Bali; a दानव. M. 6. ११; Br. III. 6. 8.
--a daughter of कालिन्दी. भा. X. ५८. २०.
--see आदित्यस्. Vi. V. 1. ५८.
--a Kulaparvata of the Uttara Kuru country. वा. ४५. २५.
--a son of मणिभद्र and पुण्यजनी; an यक्ष. Br. III. 7. १२२; वा. ६९. १५४.
--eligible for पार्वण s4ra1ddha. M. १६. 9. [page३-686+ २९]
--seen after १००० years in the २७थ् Kalpa; all yogas and mantras came out of this. वा. २१. ६५.

--the sun's chariot, made by ब्रह्मा out of the parts of the year with Vedic metres as horses; described; equal to those वरुण; his attendant गणस् in different parts of the year (one गण for every two months) and its motion detailed; has only one wheel. M. १२५. ३७-47; १२६. 1-४७; वा. ५१. ५४-67. ५२. ४२-8.
--to be revived by Manu at the end of Kali. भा. IX. १२. 6.
--in honour of the Sun god. M. १०१. ३६.
--a western country. Br. II. १६. ६०.
--observed by कृष्ण and the other Yadus by bathing in स्यमन्तपञ्चक and fasting. भा. X. ८२. 1-११. [page३-687+ २७]
